item.title: Version 2.4.9
item.description:
ForgedBrew 2.4.9

macOS 27 support. On macOS 27, ForgedBrew reported Full Disk Access as not granted no matter what System Settings said, because macOS 27 moved the data the check relied on. Full Disk Access is now detected correctly on macOS 27 and earlier, so a grant you have already made shows up as granted. If you saw the Full Disk Access needed notice after upgrading, this update is the fix and there is nothing to change in System Settings.

item.title: Version 2.4.8
item.description:
ForgedBrew 2.4.8

Homebrew 7 support. Homebrew 7 refuses to run until the Xcode license has been accepted, which left ForgedBrew showing an empty Installed list with no explanation. ForgedBrew now tells you when Homebrew cannot run and offers to accept the Xcode license for you with your administrator password, then refreshes. Any other Homebrew problem is shown at the top of the window in Homebrew's own words instead of a silently empty list, and the menu bar popover flags it too.

item.title: Version 2.4.7
item.description:
ForgedBrew 2.4.7

Fixes ForgedBrew starting silently in the menu bar with no window on an ordinary launch, and the Dock icon doing nothing until you quit and relaunched. Updates applied from the menu bar now also clear the quarantine flag on the updated app, so it opens straight away. New Settings section in the menu bar popover for background update checks, notifications and load at login, with a link to all settings.

item.title: Version 2.4.6
item.description:
ForgedBrew 2.4.6

Minor bug fixes and clean-up. The red close button now works on the first click when running from the menu bar with the Dock icon off, and opening ForgedBrew while it is already running no longer leaves you with two identical windows.

item.title: Version 2.4.5
item.description:
ForgedBrew 2.4.5

Fixed the menu-bar update password prompt that could flash and vanish on a cold launch, plus various minor fixes and clean-ups.

item.title: Version 2.4.4
item.description:
ForgedBrew 2.4.4

Expanded menu bar icon features. Clicking the menu bar icon now opens a popover with collapsible sections — Homebrew Health (brew doctor), Updates (Update All & Purge Cache, Refresh All, and per-package updates), and Appearance — so you can check your Mac's health and update Homebrew without opening the main window. You can also recolour the menu bar icon (Amber, Monochrome, Blue, Green, Red, or Purple), and a right-click still gives the classic Open / Refresh All / Quit menu.

item.title: Version 2.4.3
item.description:
ForgedBrew 2.4.3

Mac Store / Other Apps updates are now awareness-only. In-place updating (via topgrade) was silently failing — it could report success without the app actually updating — so ForgedBrew now shows available updates via MAS and you update each Mac/Other app from its own updater, or Mac App Store apps in the App Store. Deeper topgrade integration is planned for a future release. Also in this release: the Homebrew Updates buttons (Update / Update Selected / Update All) now share a consistent, calmer Homebrew-amber colorway; the Maintenance screen's brew-doctor Diagnostics is tidied up — it sits beside the health ring to reduce scrolling, and findings render as clean cards; and an internal automated test suite was added covering the update-detection, security, and version-comparison logic.

item.title: Version 2.4.2
item.description:
ForgedBrew 2.4.2

Security Scan now audits every installed app — Homebrew casks plus everything in /Applications, ~/Applications, and your custom folders — not just casks. Plus a fix for a bogus 'Installed Dec 31, 1903' date after in-app updates, and clearer quarantine-sheet wording.

item.title: Version 2.4.1
item.description:
ForgedBrew 2.4.1

Enhanced Trust Management and Homebrew security scanning ahead of Homebrew's September 1, 2026 cask-quarantine change: faster and more accurate scans (no false alarms on large apps, online notarization recognized, saved results with Re-scan, and CVSS severity ratings). Plus other cleanup and refinement: reliable installs from every screen, Cmd-Q quits, more accurate update detection, better search, and a documentation and QA hardening pass.

item.title: Version 2.4.0
item.description:
ForgedBrew 2.4.0

Further clean up and refinement, bug fixes and improvements.
